verdict.rationale: Relay supports issuing multiple virtual/physical Visa cards with spend limits and role-based controls (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-16), which enables purpose-scoped cards for things like a vendor or ad spend, but there's no evidence of instant creation flows, per-card vendor/merchant-locking, or category-specific restrictions tailored to 'ad spend' style use cases. missing for 10: evidence of instant/quick card issuance UX, vendor-lock or merchant-category restriction features, and independent confirmation of ease/speed of scoped card creation.
